entries.ecb4caee98a1a592: As an independent company not belonging to any specific hospital group, it has a structure that allows flexible coordination with local partners such as medical institutions and home-care support offices. It sets visit areas by combining data such as visit records and geography, and promotes efficiency through IT use, including managing administrative work in the cloud at its head office. Through hiring and training programs for people without home nursing experience, it also aims to make nurses and others productive early.
